claim: Check that scripted keys visibly move the player and change the game: a pace or recording run with keys the game never reads or that hit a menu measures nothing.

evidence.text: The published +0.38% pace figure used keys the game does not read; a pace run must show the player moving.
The keyboard decoder maps O/P left/right; an earlier recording sent Z/X, which tests only stationary firing.
J opens a joystick menu where K picks Kempston; a script holding Kempston directions looks like it plays while nothing moves.
P pauses this release; use Z/X/SPACE.
An ENTER tap opened the inventory during pace trials; held it reopens.
Pressing 3 at the menu toggles Wally's colour; in play 3 is colour, 4 pause, 5 tune.

next_check: After the start keys require a state byte the profile names (position, score) to change, and report "keys did not reach play" otherwise.
